propositions: COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE at src/rebar/llm/completion.py:48-65 directs FAIL callers to add ticket-comment evidence but omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite required by ADR 0043 for external evidence admissibility.
Untagged external criteria are deliberately classified as codebase-verifiable per ADR 0043 and completion_verifier.md:81-86, so ticket-comment-only evidence cannot satisfy them on retry.
The remediation guidance omission caused an operator to add concrete ticket evidence without the required tag, resulting in a second FAIL that was contractually correct but operationally futile.
FAIL remediation must distinguish repository-verifiable evidence from external operator-attested evidence and name the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite.

The remediation interface test must be strengthened to require the [operator-attested] tag, the external/repository distinction, and the statement that untagged external criteria cannot be satisfied by ticket comments alone.
